shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc "cat .lore/dod.md; cat .lore/test-commands.yml; rg --files src | rg '(chatOrchestrator|\\.test\\.)'; rg -n \"tool round|usage|afterModelResponse|scripted\" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts src/types/ai.ts"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,110p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; sed -n '380,565p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; sed -n '1,120p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts; cat package.json; rg -n \""'^[-*] |validated by|Measured semantics" specs'
/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.*#|@spec|SPEC\" src --glob '*.test.ts' | head -60; ls -a .lore; rg -n \"spec anchor|specs/|descriptor|VALIDATED_BY\" scripts .lore"
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,45p' src/orchestration/toolBudget.test.ts; cat .gitignore; git status --short --branch; git branch --show-current; git remote -v"
/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check; git diff -- .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatUsage.acceptance.test.ts; git status --short'

/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatUsage.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "Add usage aggregation acceptance test" && git push origin HEAD'
/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
